camel_example: aliyun vod AttachAppPolicyToIdentity --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyNames VODAppFullAccess --IdentityType RamRole --IdentityName 0000
description_en: Invokes this operation to attach access permissions of an ApsaraVideo VOD application to a specified identity (Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role)
description_zh: 调用本接口为指定身份（RAM用户或RAM角色）附加点播应用的访问权限
kebab_example: aliyun vod attach-app-policy-to-identity --identity-type RamRole --identity-name 0000 --policy-names VODAppFullAccess --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachAppPolicyToIdentity

parameters.help_en:
The identity type. Valid values:
RamUser: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
RamRole: RAM role
parameters.help_zh:
身份类型。取值：
RamUser：RAM用户。
RamRole：RAM角色
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en:
The identity name.

If the type is RamUser, specify the Resource Access Management (RAM) user ID.
If the type is RamRole, specify the role name
parameters.help_zh:
身份名称。

类型为RamUser时，传入RAM用户ID。
类型为RamRole时，传入角色名称
parameters.name: identity_name

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. Default value: app-1000000. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html.

If the policy name is VODAppAdministratorAccess, this parameter is optional. For other policies, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。默认取值：app-1000000。使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html。

当策略名称为VODAppAdministratorAccess时，该字段非必选。其他策略时，该字段必填
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The policy names. Separate multiple names with commas (,). Only system policies are supported. Valid values:
VODAppFullAccess: permissions to manage and operate all resources in the application.
VODAppReadOnlyAccess: read-only permissions on all resources in the application.
VODAppAdministratorAccess: application administrator permissions
parameters.help_zh:
策略名称。多个名称使用英文逗号（,）分隔，暂时只支持设置为系统策略，可选值：
VODAppFullAccess：管理和操作应用下所有资源的权限。
VODAppReadOnlyAccess：只读访问应用下所有资源的权限。
VODAppAdministratorAccess：应用管理员权限
parameters.name: policy_names

FailedPolicyNames.description_en: The policy names that failed to be attached

items.description_en: The policy names that failed to be attached

NonExistPolicyNames.description_zh: 不存在的策略名称列表
